newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.09 down at 41.25 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday on buying of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said investors were planning to deposit dollars in bank accounts under a high-profit scheme announced by Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif to attract foreign currency.

The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 3.00 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
